input.content: You are a senior PLC control systems architect. Return ONLY valid JSON.

You are a PLC control software architect. Produce a concise architecture plan (at most 2000 words). Do not enumerate exhaustive traces. Return complete JSON with keys:
- state_machine: list of states and transitions
- timer_plan: timers required, PT durations, reset conditions
- priorities: safety and operational priorities
- initial_values: initial values for variables
- scan_execution_order: explicit 4-stage scan order (1. edge sampling, 2. safety/reset priority & state transitions, 3. unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF, 4. unified output assignments)
- formal_assertions: optional list of {"id": "A1", "formula": "G(...)"} temporal/invariant assertions over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names

SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "SELF003",
  "title": "Emergency stop reset with restart inhibition",
  "difficulty": "medium",
  "requirements": "# SELF003: Safety-Reset Latched Motor Control\n\n## Background\nMotor latch requiring explicit isolated reset after power-up or E-stop loss.\n\n## Functional Requirements\n1. Inputs: `Start`, `Stop`, `EStopNC` (`TRUE` when healthy), and `Reset` (`BOOL`).\n2. If `EStopNC = FALSE`, set `ResetRequired := TRUE` and `Run := FALSE` immediately.\n3. While `ResetRequired = TRUE`, `Run` stays `FALSE`; `ResetRequired` clears to `FALSE` only when `Reset = TRUE AND Start = FALSE AND Stop = FALSE`.\n4. When `ResetRequired = FALSE` and `EStopNC = TRUE`: `Stop = TRUE` clears `Run := FALSE`; else `Start = TRUE` sets `Run := TRUE`; else `Run` retains.\n\n## Interface\n- **Inputs:** `Start: BOOL`, `Stop: BOOL`, `EStopNC: BOOL`, `Reset: BOOL`\n- **Outputs:** `Run: BOOL`, `ResetRequired: BOOL`\n\n## Initial Values\n- `Run=false`, `ResetRequired=true`\n\n## Timing & Evaluation Conventions\nSafety-circuit logic evaluates priority strictly in the order E-stop > ResetRequired > Stop > Start.",
  "scenario": "A workshop spindle requires a deliberate reset with Start released before a restart after emergency-stop release.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Start",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Start request"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Stop",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Normal stop request"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "EStopNC",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "TRUE means emergency stop released"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Reset",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Reset request"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Run",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Spindle run command"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "ResetRequired",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Restart inhibition latch"
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "Run": false,
    "ResetRequired": true
  },
  "scan_semantics": "At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "Emergency stop overrides all requests",
    "Restart inhibition overrides Start",
    "Normal stop overrides Start"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "Start": "I[k].Start: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Stop": "I[k].Stop: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "EStopNC": "I[k].EStopNC: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Reset": "I[k].Reset: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Run": "O[k].Run: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "ResetRequired": "O[k].ResetRequired: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "first": "k=0; first invocation, not the pre-invocation observation",
    "qRequired": "{\"kind\": \"previous_observed_output\", \"source\": \"O[k-1].ResetRequired\", \"initial\": true, \"update\": \"After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].ResetRequired; never write into reference state.\"}",
    "qRun": "{\"kind\": \"previous_observed_output\", \"source\": \"O[k-1].Run\", \"initial\": false, \"update\": \"After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].Run; never write into reference state.\"}",
    "validReset": "EStopNC & Reset & !Start & !Stop.",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.Run=false, O_init.ResetRequired=true."
  },
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "SELF003.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF003.P1",
      "formula": "G(first -> (qRequired & !qRun))",
      "explanation": "A fresh instance requires reset.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF003.P2",
      "formula": "G(!EStopNC -> (!Run & ResetRequired))",
      "explanation": "Emergency stop forces safe outputs immediately.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF003.P3",
      "formula": "G(qRequired -> !Run)",
      "explanation": "Reset acceptance and motor start cannot share one scan.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF003.P4",
      "formula": "G((qRequired & EStopNC) -> (ResetRequired <-> !validReset))",
      "explanation": "Reset requires released Start and Stop.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF003.P5",
      "formula": "G((!qRequired & EStopNC & !Stop & Start) -> Run)",
      "explanation": "A subsequent permitted start energizes the motor.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF003.P6",
      "formula": "G((!qRequired & EStopNC & Stop) -> !Run)",
      "explanation": "Stop has priority after reset.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF003.P7",
      "formula": "G((!qRequired & EStopNC) -> !ResetRequired)",
      "explanation": "Explicit correction of a demonstrated omission.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF003.P8",
      "formula": "G((!qRequired & EStopNC & !Stop & !Start) -> (Run <-> qRun))",
      "explanation": "Explicit correction of a demonstrated omission.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ]
}
